deadline.value: Funding deadline December 8, 2026 (apply by this date to enter the University funding competition); the final application deadline is later, but too late for most funding.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall with at least 25 in each section; this course sets its own English level.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL Internet Score Element Score Listening 25 Writing 25 Reading 25 Speaking 25 Total 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (Listening 7.0, Writing 7.0, Reading 6.5, Speaking 7.0).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic) Element Score Listening 7.0 Writing 7.0 Reading 6.5 Speaking 7.0 Total 7.0

supervisor.value: Strongly advised to speak to prospective supervisors before applying; applications with no suitable supervisor are likely to be disadvantaged or rejected.
supervisor.quote: It is strongly recommended that you speak to prospective supervisors before applying.

funding.value: Studentships from research councils, industry and charities; shortlisted candidates are entered into a scholarship competition by mid-February.
funding.quote: Studentships are available provided by UK Research Councils, industry, and charities.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's-only applicants will not usually be considered; a UK-master's equivalent is expected.
entry_route.quote: Applicants with only an undergraduate degree will not usually be considered.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

notes: Language test may be set as an offer condition and cannot be waived.
